title: Smith Kin
flagsNote: "Portsmouth line" marks proven descendants of William Smith (1920, Portsmouth); "name echo" marks a William or Peter.

orderingRows.holding: Master of the High Court for the district where the person died: Port Elizabeth for William (1990) and Anna (1999), Durban for Peter (1988) and Elizabeth (2005).
orderingRows.how: A child or grandchild may request a copy of the death notice and liquidation account from the Master's office, quoting name and date of death; identity documents are asked for.
